title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Qualifying Terms of the Federal, Extended, Trade and Disaster Programs
content:
Some programs of Unemployment Benefit Claims carry a qualifying term of their own. A figure of 0 in this schedule means the term is not applicable to that program.

| Program | Minimum continuous days of federal active military service ending in an honorable separation | Minimum weeks of full-time employment in the base period | Training enrollment deadline (weeks after the later of the qualifying separation or the petition certification) | Additional weeks of allowances in approved training after basic entitlement is exhausted | Disaster assistance period (weeks, starting the week after the disaster began) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | 90 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | 0 | 20 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | 0 | 0 | 26 | 65 | 0 |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 26 |

## The terms in words

- **Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX):** 90 days of continuous federal active military service ending in an honorable separation.
- **Extended Benefits (EB):** 20 weeks of full-time employment in the base period.
- **Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA):** enrollment in approved training within 26 weeks after the later of the qualifying separation or the petition certification; up to 65 additional weeks of allowances while in approved training after basic entitlement is exhausted.
- **Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA):** a disaster assistance period of 26 weeks starting the week after the disaster began.
